summary: Fixes SqlUtil operator lookup so the kind-based filter maps both the candidate's and the call's SqlKind through getFunctionKind(), with a validator regression test.

tests.evidence: Bug fix; regression test chains SqlStdOperatorTable with itself to reach the two-candidate pass for POSITION and CHAR_LENGTH; fails without the fix.

doc_comments.evidence: mihaibudiu: 'this comment could be shorter' and 'please do not submit useless comments'; the six-line inline comment and the 13-line test Javadoc were cut to two and four lines in the final diff.

change_description.evidence: Commit message and description explain the asymmetry and why; adequate.

backward_compat.evidence: Changes which operators survive overload resolution; previously failing calls now resolve.

error_model.evidence: Fix removes a spurious 'No match found for function signature' error; no new error paths.

correctness.evidence: Mapping the call's kind too widens matching: a POSITION call now matches every OTHER_FUNCTION-mapped candidate of the same name in the fourth pass, which a focused reviewer should check cannot pick a wrong overload.

surprising_behavior.evidence: Resolution can now succeed where it failed; unlikely to surprise.

contradictions.evidence: Comments were verbose but consistent with the code.

plan.why: One-line fix plus a test; one reviewer can cover logic and comment length.
